prompts.name: gp_cover
prompts.prompt: Clean up and refine the first image into one seamless, natural, high-quality vertical 4:5 YouTube-thumbnail style photo. Keep the composition exactly the same: the young Korean man in black glasses, black suit, white shirt and black tie in the lower-left foreground, and behind him the handwritten exam answer sheet and the white graphing calculator on the table. His face, glasses, hairstyle and expression must stay exactly identical to the real person in the second image — do not change his identity or features. Remove the cut-out halo around his hair, fix the smeared area on his tie and shirt so it looks natural, blend the lighting so he looks naturally in front of the background, sharpen and denoise. Keep the bottom 25% dark for captions. No text, letters, logos or watermarks.
